models_evaluated: 7 AI chatbots from 3 major development groups (specific names not listed in the text)

links.outcome: Chatbot answer accuracy against hearing loss clinical practice guidelines, rated by otolaryngologists
links.effect: Best chatbots fully guideline-concordant for up to 50% of questions; earlier models 25% to 37.5%. Misleading content was rare and typically not clinically significant.
links.quote: The most advanced chatbots achieved full guideline-concordant accuracy for up to 50% of questions, while earlier models ranged from 25% to 37.5%.

screen.reason: Evaluates 7 commercial LLM chatbots on patient-facing hearing loss questions compared to expert answers and rated by both clinicians and laypersons, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
